title: When the precipitation picture changes
description: The radar keeps the chosen area and tells past frames apart from the forecast.

blocks.text: A person opens the map again and every time has to find their own area and the moment they need.

quote.text: Disappointed. This is the only radar app I’ve ever seen that doesn’t show future radar….

blocks.text: Remember the zoom level, show the time of the last observation and style the forecast continuation separately. The widget leads to the same area.
The animation must not hide how old the measurements are, or present an estimate of the future as something already observed.
